issues.description: Method calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement (note about required static methods) explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be declared static and to use the shared stock. The solution implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) rather than static. This mismatch leaves students unsure whether to implement calculateTotalPrice as a static method operating on the shared stock or as an instance method, and may cause confusion about how to access the shared stock and how tests expect the method to be called.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Prefer changing the solution to match the problem statement: declare calculateTotalPrice as a static method (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) so it uses the shared static stock field. Update any internal references or tests to call SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) as needed. Alternatively, if the design should use an instance method, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice must be static and document the instance-based design; however, prefer the first option to preserve the stated shared-stock design.
